pages.title: Set up a lift
pages.text: Place an Elevator with a clear vertical shaft. Supply $(thing)10 of each flux per tick$() and set its height in the hologram.$(br2)Stand in the beam. Without multiple marked floors, Jump rises and Sneak descends. The lift stops when either power supply is lost.

pages.title: Add landing markers
pages.text: Place Level Markers at your landing heights, within two blocks horizontally of the elevator. Keep them inside its configured height.$(br2)With multiple detected floors, Jump and Sneak select the next higher or lower floor. The hologram also offers floor selection.$(br2)Keep the shaft and each landing clear.
